convertedFacts.logicSummary:
Inputs:
- x: "x", number, starts at 2.5, -10 to 10, step 0.5
- n: "n", integer, starts at 10, 0 to 20, step 1
Outputs:
- all: "All", number = x + n
convertedFacts.outline:
Every function: 
- hero #block-0 ref all
- section #auto-inputs
  - slider #auto-input-0 ref x
  - stepper #auto-input-1 ref n
sounds:
- a "Rounding": tones sine at round(x) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at round(-x) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at round(1234.5678, 2) * 100 Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at floor(x) + ceil(x) + abs(-x) Hz, amplitude 0.4
- b "Powers": tones sine at sqrt(2) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at cbrt(27) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at pow(2, 30) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at 2 ^ 3 ^ 2 Hz, amplitude 0.4
- c "Logs": tones sine at exp(1) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at log(8, 2) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at log10(1000) + log2(1024) + ln(e) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at log(100) Hz, amplitude 0.4
- d "Trigonometry": tones sine at sin(pi / 6) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at cos(0) + tan(0) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at atan2(1, 1) * 4 Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at hypot(3, 4) Hz, amplitude 0.4
- e2 "Counting": tones sine at fact(n) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at choose(n, 3) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at fact(3.5) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at choose(5, 7) + choose(2, -1) Hz, amplitude 0.4
- f "Lists": tones sine at min(3, 1, 2) + max(3, 1, 2) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at sum(1, 2, 3) + avg(2, 4) + count(0, 1, 2) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at first(7, 8) + last(7, 8) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at clamp(x, 3, 4) Hz, amplitude 0.4
- g "Signs": tones sine at sign(-x) + sign(0) + sign(x) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at mod(-7, 3) + -7 % 3 Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at if(x > 2, 1, 0) + (x < 2 ? 10 : 20) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at 1 / 3 Hz, amplitude 0.4
- h "Hyperbolic": tones sine at sinh(1) + cosh(1) + tanh(1) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at asin(1) + acos(0) + atan(1) Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at 1e-5 * 3 Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at 1_000_000 * 1e3 Hz, amplitude 0.4
- i "Big": tones sine at 10 ^ 16 Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at 2 ^ 53 + 0.5 Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at 123456789.25 * 1000 Hz, amplitude 0.4; sine at 0.1 + 0.2 Hz, amplitude 0.4
